curated.conceptDesc: Live executive telemetry dashboard filtering thousands of operational events down to vital green/red scorecard dials.
curated.oneLiner: The single vital metric that proves whether your business is winning, on track, or failing.
curated.notes: Executive scorecards monitored across weekly reviews.
curated.origin: Robert Kaplan & Peter Drucker (1992) · Balanced Scorecard

anatomy.desc: The 3 to 5 metrics that genuinely dictate company health.
Hard numbers: conversion rate, revenue growth, churn percentage.
A forward-looking gauge showing if goals will be met.
